questions.question: If cosec θ + cot θ = 3, then the value of cosec θ is:
questions.questionHtml: If cosec θ + cot θ = 3, then the value of cosec θ is:
questions.solution:
Given:

cosec θ + cot θ = 3

Use identity:

(cosec θ + cot θ)(cosec θ - cot θ) = 1

So,

3(cosec θ - cot θ) = 1

cosec θ - cot θ = 1/3

Now add:

cosec θ + cot θ = 3
cosec θ - cot θ = 1/3

2cosec θ = 10/3

cosec θ = 5/3

questions.question: The largest possible right circular cylinder is cut out from a wooden cube of edge 14 cm. Find the volume of the cube left over after cutting the cylinder in cm³. Use π = 22/7.
questions.questionHtml: The largest possible right circular cylinder is cut out from a wooden cube of edge 14 cm. Find the volume of the cube left over after cutting the cylinder in cm³. Use π = 22/7.
questions.solution:
Cube edge = 14 cm

Largest cylinder inside cube:

Radius = 14/2 = 7 cm
Height = 14 cm

Cube volume = 14³ = 2744 cm³

Cylinder volume = 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 14 = 2156 cm³

Leftover volume = 2744 - 2156 = 588 cm³

questions.question: When 548 is divided by a positive integer x, the remainder is 13. How many values of x are there?
questions.questionHtml: When 548 is divided by a positive integer x, the remainder is 13. How many values of x are there?
questions.solution:
548 leaves remainder 13 when divided by x.

So,

x must divide:

548 - 13 = 535

Now,

535 = 5 × 107

Factors of 535:

1, 5, 107, 535

But remainder 13 should be smaller than divisor.

So, x > 13

Possible values:

107, 535

Answer: 2

questions.question: If the digits of a two-digit number are reversed, the number is reduced by 45. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the number? I. The difference between the digits is 5. II. The original number could be 83. III. The original number is always an odd number.
questions.questionHtml:
If the digits of a two-digit number are reversed, the number is reduced by 45. Which of the following statements is correct regarding the number?

I. The difference between the digits is 5.
II. The original number could be 83.
III. The original number is always an odd number.
questions.solution:
Original number - Reversed number = 45

For a two-digit number:

Difference = 9 × difference of digits

So,

9 × difference of digits = 45

Difference of digits = 5

Now check statements:

I. Difference between digits is 5 = True
II. 83 is possible because 83 - 38 = 45 = True
III. Number is always odd = False
Possible numbers: 50, 61, 72, 83, 94

Answer: (c) I and II

questions.question: Fourth proportional to 15, 20, and 9 is the same as the third proportional to k and 6. What is the value of k?
questions.questionHtml: Fourth proportional to 15, 20, and 9 is the same as the third proportional to k and 6. What is the value of k?
questions.solution:
Fourth proportional to 15, 20, 9 = x

15 : 20 = 9 : x

15x = 20 × 9

15x = 180

x = 12

So, the fourth proportional = 12

Now, third proportional to k and 6 = 12

k : 6 = 6 : 12

k × 12 = 6 × 6

12k = 36

k = 3

questions.question: P can complete a project in 36 days and Q can do it in 45 days. Along with R, they managed to complete the entire project in 10 days only. Then, R alone can complete the project in how many days?
questions.questionHtml: P can complete a project in 36 days and Q can do it in 45 days. Along with R, they managed to complete the entire project in 10 days only. Then, R alone can complete the project in how many days?
questions.solution:
LCM of 36, 45 and 10 = 180

Total work = 180 units

P’s 1 day work = 180/36 = 5 units

Q’s 1 day work = 180/45 = 4 units

P + Q + R’s 1 day work = 180/10 = 18 units

R’s 1 day work = 18 - 5 - 4 = 9 units

R alone time = 180/9 = 20 days
